items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday; consecutive DNPs after Week 4 injuries. Barkley week-to-week and not expected for Week 5 London game vs JAX per reports.
items.why: Hamstring injuries; Barkley left Week 4 early, Smith missed prior.
items.implication: Likely OUT or limited for PHI @ JAX; elevates remaining RBs/WRs.
items.opportunity: Lead back and WR1 snaps/targets open if OUT.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not practice Thursday due to ankle injury. Friday’s practice looms large for Sunday night availability vs ATL.
items.implication: GTD or risk OUT; monitor Friday closely for SNF.

items.text: ETR/Levitan: With Barkley (hamstring, week-to-week) and Bigsby (abdomen, IR/core surgery) out, 'it's gonna be the Will Shipley show against Jacksonville.' Waiver elevation for lead role.
items.why: Only healthy primary RB left after injuries/IR.
items.implication: High-priority waiver add for volume/flex in PHI backfield vs JAX.
items.opportunity: Carries, snaps, possible GL/pass work expansion.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.why: Shoulder; left early previously, AC joint context.
items.implication: Questionable trending; impacts BUF WR depth/targets.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey no practice again Thursday (foot); second straight DNP after aggravating in Week 4.
items.implication: Trending doubtful/OUT vs DEN; monitor final report.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to other LAC WRs/TE if out.

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift limited (knee/hip); Kyle Monangai DNP second straight (thumb/toe).
items.implication: CHI RB committee uncertainty; Swift still primary if available.
items.opportunity: If both limited, other backs elevate.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins vs Titans; ranks WR8. Strong volume/red-zone and matchup.
items.why: Target hog, RZ volume, Titans defense struggles vs WRs.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload and matchup vs soft run D, plus Bengals WR injury context boosting checkdowns.
items.why: Solid workload; defenses carved by RBs; CIN pass injuries.
items.conflict: Levitan notes underperforming xFP so far.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot injury (plantar fasciitis); coach said he'll miss multiple weeks.
items.implication: Extended absence; PIT WR targets shift.
items.opportunity: More work for DK Metcalf and other PIT WRs.

items.text: Puka Nacua returned and played 76-of-84 snaps, ran 49 routes on 64 dropbacks, 12 targets + goal-line carry despite prior hip/groin hysteria.
items.why: Post-return snap/route/target data shows no restriction.
items.implication: Full WR1 role confirmed; strong ROS confidence.
items.opportunity: High snaps, routes, targets, GL work intact.

items.text: Titans WR Carnell Tate limited Thursday with back injury.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 5 vs HOU availability.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson (WR10 vs DET), Christian Watson (WR15 vs CHI), Isaiah Likely (TE5 @ WSH) for volume/matchup reasons.
items.why: Volume/RZ for Wilson; coverage/pos weaknesses for Watson/Likely.

items.text: Berry hates Jordan Addison (@ NO, WR41), Mark Andrews (@ ATL, TE17); also fades some others on tough matchups/thin roles/usage.
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, usage numbers, Addison injury wrinkle.

items.text: Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming theirs (xFP data).
items.why: Expected vs actual FP on opportunities through ~4 weeks.
items.implication: Bijan/Kyren efficiency sustain or regress watch; Jeanty/Chase Brown buy-low opportunity if volume holds.
items.opportunity: Focus on underlying opportunities over raw points.
